name: PixiBud smart tools execute Auto-Shade, Clean Jaggies, and Mood Tints
description: Verify opening the PixiBud smart assistant tab and triggering Auto-Shade, Clean Jaggies, and Warm Sunset actions.

planSteps.description: Click the PixiBud AI tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the PixiBud action buttons are displayed including Auto-Shade, Highlight, Clean Jaggies, and Warm Sunset
Verify a feedback banner appears stating Curved shadow crescent painted onto your sprite
Click the Clean Jaggies action button
Verify a feedback banner appears stating Staircase corners smoothed flat
Click the Warm Sunset mood tint button
Verify a feedback banner appears stating Dusk light washed across the canvas
